rules.name: Mass File Encryption Pattern
rules.description: Detection rules for ransomware indicators: encryption patterns, C2 behavior, lateral movement preceding ransomware deployment
rules.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4688 | where NewProcessName contains "mass" or CommandLine contains "file" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, Account, NewProcessName | where count_ > 5 // AZ-RANSOMWARE-077
